Download the example metadata, PostgreSQL queries and report templates supplied with `db.atlas`.

Use [Getting started](atlas.html) to load the snapshot and [Schema reports](reports.html) to render it.

## Downloads

```{r resources-archive, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Read the version used in the downloadable archive name.
resources_version <- as.character(utils::packageVersion("db.atlas"))
# Offer the versioned archive on the website.
if (identical(Sys.getenv("IN_PKGDOWN"), "true")) {
  cat(sprintf("[Download package resources (%s, ZIP)](../db.atlas-resources-%s.zip).\n\n",
    resources_version, resources_version))
}
```

The archive preserves the directory layout of the installed resources.

```{r resources-tables, include=FALSE}
# Locate the installed package files.
resources_directory <- system.file(package = "db.atlas")
# List the files for one group, with downloads on the website.
resource_table <- function(directory, descriptions) {
  files <- list.files(file.path(resources_directory, directory), recursive = TRUE)
  labels <- sprintf("`%s`", files)
  if (identical(Sys.getenv("IN_PKGDOWN"), "true")) {
    # Use absolute download URLs so pkgdown preserves Markdown files as downloads.
    urls <- paste0("https://ultreia-io.github.io/db.atlas/", directory, "/", files)
    labels <- sprintf("[`%s`](%s)", files, urls)
  }
  knitr::kable(data.frame(File = labels, Purpose = unname(descriptions[files])), format = "pipe")
}
```

### Survey example

The snapshot models the sheets and catalogues used in the shared `form.*` survey example.

```{r metadata-files, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Describe the five CSV components read by read_metadata().
resource_table("examples/survey", c(
  "README.md" = "Survey example layout and usage notes.",
  "metadata/schemas_description.csv" = "Schemas and their descriptions.",
  "metadata/tables_description.csv" = "Tables and their descriptions.",
  "metadata/tables_columns.csv" = "Column names, types, nullability and descriptions.",
  "metadata/tables_foreign_keys.csv" = "Ordered foreign key columns and their targets.",
  "metadata/tables_primary_keys.csv" = "Ordered primary key columns."
))
```

### PostgreSQL queries

```{r sql-files, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Describe the PostgreSQL catalogue queries used during extraction.
resource_table("sql", c(
  "get_schemas_description.sql" = "Read schema descriptions.",
  "get_tables_description.sql" = "Read table descriptions.",
  "get_tables_columns.sql" = "Read column metadata and descriptions.",
  "get_tables_foreign_keys.sql" = "Read foreign key columns and their targets.",
  "get_tables_primary_keys.sql" = "Read primary key columns."
))
```

### Report templates

```{r template-files, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Describe the defaults used to render reports and graphs.
resource_table("templates", c(
  "atlas.css" = "Report styles.",
  "report.Rmd.tpl" = "R Markdown report template.",
  "report.js" = "Report interactions.",
  "graph.css" = "Dependency graph styles.",
  "graph.js" = "Dependency graph interactions."
))
```

## Installed resources

```{r installed-resources}
# Locate the same example, queries and templates without downloading files.
system.file("examples", "survey", package = "db.atlas")
system.file("sql", package = "db.atlas")
system.file("templates", package = "db.atlas")
```
